import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load Data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Extract columns
author_map = {"EAP": 0, "HPL": 1, "MWS": 2}
y = train_df["author"].map(author_map)
X_text_train = train_df["text"].values
test_text = test_df["text"].values
test_ids = test_df["id"].values

# Split Training Data into Train and Validation (stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_text_train, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

# Vectorize Training Data with Stopwords removed for word features
# Char features remain as before
word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, stop_words="english"
)
char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", max_features=25000, ngram_range=(2, 4), min_df=2
)

# Fit word features on train only
word_vec.fit(X_train)
X_train_word = word_vec.transform(X_train)
X_val_word = word_vec.transform(X_val)

# Fit char features on train only
char_vec.fit(X_train)
X_train_char = char_vec.transform(X_train)
X_val_char = char_vec.transform(X_val)

# Combine features
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])

# Train Model
clf = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=2000, C=1.0, random_state=42, solver="lbfgs", multi_class="auto"
)
clf.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Validation Metric
val_probs = clf.predict_proba(X_val_combined)
val_probs = np.clip(val_probs, 1e-15, 1.0)
val_loss = log_loss(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation Log Loss (Hold-out): {val_loss:.6f}")

# Final Model for Submission (Train on all Train Data)
word_vec_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=10000, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, stop_words="english"
)
char_vec_full = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb", max_features=25000, ngram_range=(2, 4), min_df=2
)

word_vec_full.fit(X_text_train)
X_train_word_full = word_vec_full.transform(X_text_train)

char_vec_full.fit(X_text_train)
X_train_char_full = char_vec_full.transform(X_text_train)

X_train_full_combined = hstack([X_train_word_full, X_train_char_full])

clf_full = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=2000, C=1.0, random_state=42, solver="lbfgs", multi_class="auto"
)
clf_full.fit(X_train_full_combined, y)

# Predict Test
X_test_word = word_vec_full.transform(test_text)
X_test_char = char_vec_full.transform(test_text)
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

test_probs = clf_full.predict_proba(X_test_combined)
test_probs = np.clip(test_probs, 1e-15, 1.0)

# Prepare Submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_ids,
        "EAP": test_probs[:, 0],
        "HPL": test_probs[:, 1],
        "MWS": test_probs[:, 2],
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
